execution.entry_reason: The official entry random_model_gen (graph_gen.py:1061) constructs a PureSymbolGen, whose post_process is SimpleGenerator.post_process (a no-op, line 180) and whose extra_constraints always returns [] (PureSymbolGen.extra_constraints, line 668). GuidedGen is never instantiated anywhere in the repository, so the step-4 'override' step abstract_gen -> GuidedGen.post_process is not real and the target line is unreachable from call_chain[0]. We therefore build a real GuidedGen (real __init__, real param_config) and call the target function GuidedGen.extra_constraints directly on a real AbsOpBase node; the target and its function body are unmodified.
